name: Liraglutide
description: Synthetic version of the gut hormone GLP-1 (97% the same sequence), with a fatty acid attached

note.text: Victoza is approved for type 2 diabetes; Saxenda for weight. FDA records say Saxenda is to be discontinued in Jan 2027.

bullets: **Binds and activates** the GLP-1 receptor, like the body's own GLP-1 (label)
**Resists breakdown** by the enzymes DPP-4 and NEP
**Lowers weight** by lowering calorie intake, not by raising 24-hour energy use
**Brain appetite areas** reached by the drug in animal studies

notEstablished.text: Weight benefit below 3 mg a day

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once daily
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak at 11 hours; resists DPP-4 and NEP breakdown
practical.monitored: Weight, HbA1c; heart rate and kidney function per label

regulatory.text: On shortage list; compounded not FDA approved

references: Pi-Sunyer et al., SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes, N Engl J Med, Jul 2015
